run_nerf_training: run the NeRF training loop with hydra config to train a radiance field model on a dataset
resume_nerf_training: resume NeRF training from a saved checkpoint file with model, optimizer, and stats
create_radiancfieldrenderer: create a RadianceFieldRenderer model with configurable ray sampler and implicit function parameters
load_nerf_datasets: load training and validation NeRF datasets using get_nerf_datasets for a given dataset name
visualize_nerf_outputs: visualize NeRF rendering outputs including coarse and fine RGB results using Visdom
